name: wave-skills
description: Execute a wave of sub-plans one link per session without drowning the controller's context. Three skills — wave-prep, wave-run, wave-close — plus the evidence auditor and architecture reviewer they dispatch. Requires superpowers: a wave is the sub-plans its spec-driven development writes, and wave-run runs each task through its subagent-driven-development scripts. The controller never reads a plan body, because six plans of one real wave are 3752 lines.
